$note: THE FRESH SET. Written AFTER the lexicon and the constants were finished, and never used to tune either. The main gold set drove the lexicon -- every miss it reported became an alias line -- so its recall number is partly a measure of that loop and cannot be read as generalisation. This file can be. Nothing here was consulted while writing config/capability-aliases.json, and no case in it may ever be used to justify an alias; when one fails it is recorded as a failure and the fix, if any, is judged on whether the phrasing is general.
